page_title: CAD 2-0 ATM | Cadiz CF v Atletico Madrid 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Salim El Jebari (Atl. Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes ignores the protests.
89' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows the yellow card to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
87' It's time for a substitution. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) comes on in place of Ruben Sobrino.
85' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
85' Arthur Vermeeren (Atl. Madrid) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
82' Conan Ledesma is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Salim El Jebari (Atl. Madrid), pushing the ball around the post to safety.

79' Gabriel Paulista (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes no option but to blow his whistle. Cadiz CF earn a free kick.
79' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Samuel Lino will be replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (Atl. Madrid).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Navarro departs the field of play to be replaced by Lucas Pires (Cadiz).
78' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Koke is replaced by Salim El Jebari (Atl. Madrid).
73' The referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes awards Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) a yellow card.

73' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Conan Ledesma shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
69' Here is a change. Maximiliano Gomez is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Chris Ramos (Cadiz).
69' Rominigue Kouame goes off the pitch and Diadie Samassekou (Cadiz) comes on.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Juanmi will be replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
66' The ball falls kindly for Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
64' 2 - 0 Juanmi (Cadiz) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
63' A yellow card for a tackle by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

62' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
62' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) commits a foul after dangerous play. Atl. Madrid win a free kick.
61' The referee blows his whistle as Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' An attempted cross from Robert Navarro (Cadiz) is cleared.

57' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Cadiz CF.

56' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
56' Cadiz CF have a corner.
53' The foul by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
53' The attendance is 15917.
50' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
48' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) receives a yellow card.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid). He is replaced by Angel Correa.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Simeone decided to make a change. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme.
46' Half-time substitution. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) will not participate anymore and Nahuel Molina is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cadiz CF.
45' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.

44' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
43' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) is penalised for a foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had a clear view and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
42' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
42' A player from Atl. Madrid commits a rough challenge. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Cadiz CF are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Surely that's handball by one of the Cadiz CF players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
39' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
37' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
37' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid in a dangerous position.
35' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

32' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma pulls off an easy save.
31' Today's referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes rightly decides to book Juanmi (Cadiz) for his harsh tackle.
30' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
28' A clumsy foul by Juanmi (Cadiz) and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle.
28' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atl. Madrid was in an offside position.
27' Conan Ledesma pulls off a great save to deny Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Ruben Sobrino swings the ball deep into the box and finds Juanmi (Cadiz) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top right corner. 1:0.
22' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
17' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
16' Gabriel Paulista (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball in, but Conan Ledesma comfortably gathers the ball.
13' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Cadiz CF will take a free kick near the side line.

12' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
10' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
9' Juanmi (Cadiz) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
8' A pass by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick.
6' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a set piece. Cadiz CF get a free kick.
6' Gabriel Paulista (Atl. Madrid) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
3' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes was nominated as the referee for this game.
